note: Stand-in for shared/contracts/evaluator/full.json, which is not in this repository. The five dimensions and weights are the Peer Review standard of academic-paper SKILL.md (Quality Standards 14). F-condition ids and their severity order are copied from agents/peer_reviewer_agent.md (Phase 6b); their definitions are written by the orchestrator and recorded as decision C10 in paper/config.md.
project_rules_checked_under_D3: Every number comes from an admitted gold-label file named in paper/config.md decision C1, and matches that file exactly.
No claim of statistical significance for a difference between models.
No faithfulness or external-validation outcome is stated while those results are [GAP] placeholders.
No result is framed as a negative or null finding; no dead ends, provisional results, retracted analyses or attic work appear.
Every cited source is in the verified corpus paper/phase1/references.bib and is used for what its annotation says it establishes.

failure_conditions.fires_when: Any mandatory dimension (D2, D3, D4) scores block.
A citation is outside the verified corpus, misattributed, or a number does not match its admitted file.
A Critical-severity issue under the skill's Checkpoint Rule 4 is found in the review body.
Structural drift: the draft's section structure departs from the approved outline without a recorded reason.
A non-mandatory dimension (D1, D5) scores block, or the evaluator disagrees with the writer's self-score on a non-mandatory dimension.
The in-pair revision loop has reached round 2 and a mandatory-dimension block recurs.
